name: negroni
description: An open-source advertising system with five reviewable phases, five-step Gemini Deep Research, Draper, and a shared Learning Core.

interface.shortDescription: Run a reviewable AI advertising workflow.
interface.longDescription: Run vertical-agnostic lead-generation research through five ordered Gemini Deep Research prompts, review the final prompt, and preserve a polished Google Doc plus brand-scoped Markdown for Creative. Talk to Draper across research, creative, launch preparation, iteration, and continuous learning with honest blocked states and explicit approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Open or create my private Negroni workspace.
Ask Draper how my campaign loop is doing.
Start editable Gemini Deep Research for my lead offer.
